'''Sven Schlosser''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Bochum Grand Slam]] on 30 January 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ / Duel]], according to Johan van der Meer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d251">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-grand-slam-bochum-30-january-2000d251/ grand-slam-bochum-30-january-2000], DeckTech (Johan "Johan" van der Meer, 14 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-grand-slam-bochum-30-january-2000d251/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
